relationship_description: Antonio Ernesto Lagdameo is the grandson of Antonio Floirendo, Sr., founder of the Floirendo political and business dynasty in Davao del Norte.
Antonio Ernesto Lagdameo is the son of Antonio Lagdameo Sr., a former ambassador and member of the Lagdameo political family.
Antonio Ernesto Lagdameo is married to Linda Floirendo, linking the Lagdameo and Floirendo dynasties.
